item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that Li Yuhan was sentenced to six and a half years in October after being detained since late 2017; she reportedly had limited contact with lawyers and medical care and allegedly suffered other abuse. The excerpt also says the Anti-Espionage Law was amended in April to broaden the definition of espionage and grant additional investigative powers.","notes":["The excerpt does not contain the stated Xu Zhiyong, Ding Jiaxi, or Chang Weiping sentences or the associated torture report."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In July 2023, the ICRC, China's National Committee on International Humanitarian Law, and the International Academy of Red Cross and Red Crescent concluded a five-day IHL summer session at Soochow University with 40 participants from government, legislative, cultural, Red Cross, military, police, military-industry, think-tank, and university institutions. The curriculum covered IHL principles, humanitarian action, urban warfare, case studies, discussions, and policy; a Zhejiang Sci-Tech University official said she planned to launch a pilot master's course in international human-rights and humanitarian law in early September.","notes":["The excerpt documents a stated plan for the course, not its confirmed launch."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E013","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"At the December 2023 Central Conference on Work Relating to Foreign Affairs, Xi Jinping delivered an address, and the conference described China's external-work direction as guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy, centralized CPC leadership, sovereignty and security interests, Belt and Road cooperation, global-governance initiatives, and building a community with a shared future for mankind. It also called for stronger strategic planning, institutional reform, personnel development, coordination, and more science-based, forward-looking, proactive, and innovative external work.","notes":["The excerpt describes speeches, plans, requirements, and guidance; it does not explicitly say that the conference adopted a comprehensive external-work program."]}]}
